KEYWORD	"DELTACHROME_REFERENCE_BASIS"
DELTACHROME_REFERENCE_BASIS	"manufacturer_nominal"
KEYWORD	"DELTACHROME_NOMINAL_SOURCE"
DELTACHROME_NOMINAL_SOURCE	"OpenDICE's Profile_FADGI_19264_Commercial.txt, published with its sample capture of unit S/N F00025. The sample names are 1 to 168 in reading order over the occupied cells; this version of the chart prints grid labels A-N by 1-16 instead of those numbers, and the definition records the printed label beside every patch so the two can be reconciled."
KEYWORD	"DELTACHROME_NOMINAL_CAVEAT"
DELTACHROME_NOMINAL_CAVEAT	"The values are batch averages, not design aims and not a measurement of the chart in front of you. Their own arithmetic says so: they quantize to 0.002 rather than to 0.01, which is what a mean of five readings each taken to two decimals does, and ISA print the same convention outright on the Golden Thread Object Level Target -- 'All values are batch averages'. A batch mean sits closer to any individual unit than a design aim would, which makes it better data; it also looks exactly like a per-unit measurement and is not, which is why a run against it reports ADVISORY and makes no conformance claim for the specimen. THIS FILE AND THE EARLY VERSION'S ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE -- see the early version's file for the evidence. The neutral ramp is the one part the two do share: all sixteen densities are identical to the digit."
